tasks.label: Build Entire C++ Project
args: $src = Get-ChildItem -Path '${workspaceFolder}\src' -Recurse -Filter '*.cpp' | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName }; $includes = Get-ChildItem -Path '${workspaceFolder}\includes' -Recurse -Directory | ForEach-Object { '-I' + $_.FullName }; & 'C:\msys64\mingw64\bin\g++.exe' -std=c++23 -Wall -Wextra -g '-I${workspaceFolder}\includes' $includes $src '-o' '${workspaceFolder}\bin\App.exe'; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
tasks.detail: Recursively build the entire C++ project
